name: Ghido
source: The owner of Green Drops, a tavern in town. The tavern offers services as a dining hall and is frequented by many students from Nirvana. Ghido is cheerful and friendly, and many of the male students trust him. He seems to be especially close with Lustin, who is a regular. He is a doting father to Collette.
